paper_title: Extended Axion Dark Matter Search Using the CAPP18T Haloscope
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, approximate from ~0.7x KSVZ
notes: Haloscope search 4.8077-4.8181 GHz, mass 19.883-19.926 ueV. Best limit ~0.7x|g_KSVZ| or ~1.9x|g_DFSZ| at 90% C.L. (Bayesian). Coupling value estimated: KSVZ g_agamma at ~20 ueV is roughly 9.3e-16 GeV^-1, so 0.7x ~ 6.5e-16 GeV^-1. Exact per-mass values are in Fig.4 exclusion plot (not numerically tabulated in text); emitted as an approximate flat horizontal band across the excluded mass range.
